claim: Momentum, mean reversion, strong-trend and calm-trend are all indistinguishable from 0.500.
contradiction_conditions: a price transform clearing 0.500 at n_eff >= 30 under walk-forward evaluation
impact: price transforms are closed as a FAMILY, not one at a time
limitations: does not generalise beyond price transforms
title: Price-transform signals have no edge on this universe

contradiction_conditions: a subclass of event showing drift at n_eff >= 100
impact: best-powered result in the project; event drift is closed
title: 8-K/6-K event drift does not exist at a detectable magnitude

limitations: n_eff 49 is modest; a small effect could hide
title: Periodic-report drift does not exist

claim: Insider buying, activist stakes and proxy drift reach n_eff 1, 3 and 10; design effect up to 4352x.
contradiction_conditions: a data source giving n_eff >= 30 for one of them
impact: stop proposing them until data depth changes
limitations: a statement about DATA DEPTH, not about the mechanisms
title: Slow-mechanism hypotheses are unmeasurable at reachable depth

claim: Ablation: 2 of 2 positions flip to WATCH when industry evidence is removed; 0 spuriously unlocked.
contradiction_conditions: an ablation showing positions survive removal
impact: the only positive result in the ledger
limitations: n=2. Cannot validate a signal, only unlock live decisions.
scope: live path only — replay depth is 87 days
title: Industry evidence causally unlocks decisions

claim: Overlapping windows are merged before any rate is reported.
contradiction_conditions: a case where naive n is the honest denominator
impact: caught the 0.359 false discovery on day 3
scope: every statistical claim in the project
title: Effective sample size, not row count

claim: More companies raise effective evidence only when they add independent cross-sectional events.
contradiction_conditions: a universe expansion that raises n_eff proportionally
impact: stopped 'add more companies' being treated as free power
title: Event frequency is the enemy of independence

claim: A simulation that omits a wired component will conclude the component does nothing.
contradiction_conditions: a fixture-based ranking later confirmed live
impact: day 8's conclusion was retracted on day 9
limitations: learned from ONE incident; not re-validated since
title: Fixtures are insufficient for ranking bottlenecks

claim: Corroboration requires an author other than the subject AND a category that can speak to the claim. Never traded off.
contradiction_conditions: a claim corroborated by satisfying only one
title: Independence and relevance are separate conditions

claim: 13 of 175 real documents express a source that differs from their subject; 19% carry more than one subject.
contradiction_conditions: a corpus where source and subject always agree
impact: two-dimensional evidence semantics; changed no decision
limitations: measured once, on one corpus; not re-validated since
title: Authorship is not subject

claim: Three days of 3%, 8%, 4% satisfies a three-day rule and establishes nothing. The test is dispersion, not duration.
contradiction_conditions: a stable conclusion reached on duration alone
impact: replaced the calendar rule with CV <= 40% and n >= 5
title: Calendar time is not evidence

claim: A horizon is never shortened to increase power.
contradiction_conditions: a mechanism whose natural horizon is genuinely ambiguous
impact: blocks the most tempting form of p-hacking here
limitations: asserted as doctrine; not re-validated since
title: Horizons belong to mechanisms, never to statistical power

claim: 1 of 7 engineering predictions has been correct.
contradiction_conditions: accuracy rising above 50% over the next 10 predictions
impact: the reason measurement precedes building, every cycle
limitations: n=7. Measures THIS project's intuition, nothing else.
title: Intuition about this system's bottlenecks is ~14% accurate

claim: The leakage guard compared a UTC retrieval stamp against an as_of expressed in the operating timezone. Between 20:00 and midnight America/Toronto, UTC has rolled over, so every freshly-retrieved observation was dated tomorrow and dropped. The symptom was `evidence: 0` -- indistinguishable from 'nothing was published today'.
contradiction_conditions: a guard that is correct without a timezone frame
impact: the 20:30 night cycle sits inside the broken window nightly; an integrity guard can fail by being too strict, and that failure mode is SILENT because it produces a plausible zero
limitations: found on the live path; replay was never affected
scope: every point-in-time guard in the project
title: Point-in-time guards must compare timezone-consistent frames

claim: A coefficient of variation answers whether a number is reliable, never whether it is good. Reported as two columns.
contradiction_conditions: a case where stability alone implies health
impact: stops a column of green STABLE labels hiding `signal_fired = 0.00`
limitations: the degraded threshold (0.25) is a labelling choice and is never optimised against
title: Statistical stability is not desirability
